channel.title: Play to Grow updates
channel.description: A dated record of public Play to Grow changes without participant personal data.

item.title: In-game progress instead of a time cap
item.description: The demo now includes a visible weekly game plan, manual achievement and play-time logging, review of in-game results, and points for confirmed achievements. The hard time limit was removed; minutes are used only as context. Missing the plan leads to an optional extra quest without hidden penalties.

item.title: Bilingual pages and open indexing
item.description: Separate Russian and English pages were added for parents, children, and psychologists, together with the method, safety, pilot, and FAQ. Sitemaps, crawler rules, and machine-readable project information were added.

item.title: Two synchronized public releases
item.description: Both domains were synchronized, Russian remained the default language, and English stayed available through the language switch. Demo role navigation and the return to the start page were clarified.
